plan.tagline: Automate overdue invoice reminders for freelancers with zero setup.
plan.problem: Freelancers waste hours weekly chasing late payments, hurting cash flow and productivity.
plan.solution: CLI tool that tracks invoices, sends polite automated reminders, and generates overdue reports—all offline-first with local SQLite storage.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small business owners who invoice clients globally but lack accounting software.
plan.demo_script: Run `invoicechase --demo` to see 3 overdue invoices auto-generated with client names, amounts, and reminder dates. Lists them sorted by urgency.
plan.phuket_angle: Perfect for Phuket-based freelancers (e.g., diving instructors, tour guides) who invoice international clients but struggle with timezone delays in payments.
